subtitle: A budget flagship that punches way above its price and turns heavy games into easy wins 🎮🔥
whatMakesItSpecial: This isn’t just another mid-range phone pretending to be fast. The Poco X6 Pro was built around raw gaming performance first — a flagship-level processor, ultra-fast RAM, and one of the smoothest displays in its price range. It feels like a phone made for gamers who want power without paying flagship money.

performance.realWorldImpact: Runs heavy games smoother than most phones in the same price range and keeps performance stable even in long gaming sessions.

benchmark.note: Raw numbers are flagship-level for a mid-range price, which is why gamers love it.

display.experience: Super sharp visuals and very smooth gameplay, especially in competitive shooters.

battery.smartCharging: Optimized charging system reduces heat during gaming

temperature.comfortLevel: Gets warm during heavy games but still comfortable for long sessions.
